prose: Dr. Craig Koniver is a true frontiersman of the coming age of independent and holistic healthcare. I've known Dr. Koniver for years now, as one of my best returning clients for biofield tuning, so I know he's truly hip to the mind-body-emotion synergy when it comes to health. But beyond that, he's also been a leader on the cutting edge for various treatments of the biochemical sort, an area that I have much to learn about, and I'm excited to share this conversation with you.
topics: Craig’s journey from MD to frontier healer
Why he left the insurance system & “7-minute medicine”
Mind-body synergy and belief’s role in biology
How light, sleep, and rhythm shape our health
The truth about peptides: clinical use vs. hype
Personalized testing & lab diagnostics as healing tools
Peptide protocols for energy, trauma, clarity & hormones
Hormones as “kids on a playground” needing balance
The power of presence: healing through witnessing
Why emotion amplifies the success of protocols
The future of medicine: coherence over chemistry
